generated.label: 2D item
generated.description: Flat item like paper or gems. Further PNGs are stacked on top as additional layers.

handheld.label: 2D tool / weapon
handheld.description: Like item/generated, but held at an angle in the hand like a sword or pickaxe.

handheldRod.label: 2D rod / fishing rod
handheldRod.description: Held in the hand like a fishing rod or a stick.

cubeAll.label: Block – one texture
cubeAll.description: Cube with the same texture on all sides (e.g. ore, stone).

cubeBottomTop.label: Block – top/bottom/side
cubeBottomTop.description: Separate textures for top, bottom and the sides (e.g. sandstone).

cube.label: Block – six sides
cube.description: Every side gets its own texture.

cross.label: Plant (cross)
cross.description: Two crossed planes like flowers – ideal for StringBlocks.
